snippet.title: Echoes: A Transmissions Story | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Follow the transmissions of The Creator to guide a curious little robot across a vibrant and whimsical world. Explore, scrap, and craft your way through an emotional story of determination, self-discovery, and finding your place among the stars.

Wishlist Now - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1884660/Echoes_A_Transmissions_Story/ 

Super Rare Originals are digital publishers of exceptional indie games across Nintendo, PlayStation, Xbox, and PC platforms, guided by a mission to support talented developers who pour their heart and soul into their games. 

If you adore indie games as much as we do, you’re in the perfect place.
